svg.title: Mochaa (naichii) — a Frieren-themed travel journal
svg.desc: A Frieren-themed profile for Mochaa, a versatile software engineer, written as a travel journal that heads north from spring meadows to snow, illustrated with official art (©K.Y.T.A/S/FP). Chapter 1, After the Journey's End: name, class, craft (web development and workflow automation), spec-driven development, open to collaboration, beside the official visual of Himmel and Frieren with blue moon weed. Chapter 2, Memories Along the Road, over a faded copy of the official journey map: the current full-stack role and its quests, then flashbacks of past roles back to computer engineering. Chapter 3, A Chest in the Dungeon: the open-source side quest ai-engineering-starter, the official visual of Frieren head first in a mimic, an Episode 23 still of Fern pulling her out as Exhibit A, and a tally of mimics against Frieren. Chapter 4, Useless Magic, Collected: the tech stack as six spells, each with its still from the official magic page (TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, Python, React, Svelte, Astro, Express, Laravel, Elysia, Hono, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Node.js, Bun, Vite, npm, Composer, Git, Docker, Nginx). Chapter 5, Concealed Mana: GitHub activity with a 6 day current streak, a 15 day longest streak and 2211 contributions this year, drawn as a flower field. Epilogue, To the North: links to X and GitHub beside an Episode 2 still of Himmel's statue. Between chapters, the party's official chibi characters, and Frieren asleep.

g.text: Fifty years on, a new journey begins.
“This time, I want to understand the people I build for.”
a lesson that took an elf fifty years to learn
since Aug 2026 · heading north, one quest at a time
kept the town crier on schedule
the first dungeon. Scared like Stark; held the line anyway.
taught apprentices, as Flamme once taught Frieren
practised daily until the spell hit the distant rock
Five years, as humans count them. For an elf, a short nap.
This one really is a grimoire.
Digs up exactly the rows you need.
Spell to keep shell out of a
Also inside: turning sweet grapes sour, and removing rust from bronze statues.
Fern says half of these are useless. Frieren uses them every day.
— the next morning (Fern got her up by noon) —
Suppressed, as always. A demon would read this and guess wrong.
A year as a flower field: one bloom for every day of work.
— Northern Lands, five years after the first commit —
Shall we travel together for a while?
Himmel had statues built so Frieren
wouldn’t be alone in the future.
I write documentation for the same reason.
(Need a hand? It’s what Himmel the Hero would have done.)
